mawfish.name: Mawfish
mawfish.description: Its gaping maw allows it to scoop up smaller fish as it swims by them.

mirewinder.name: Mirewinder
mirewinder.description: Surveys the water for impurities. It can be found in cave pools on Venus.

mortus-lungfish.name: Mortus Lungfish
mortus-lungfish.description: Displays blood-spattered pattern on its scales and has its ribs exposed through open cavities along both flanks. When predators approach it lies still at the bottom of the sand banks, disguised as a carcass in hopes of being ignored.

murkray.name: Murkray
murkray.description: A cunning hunter that hides within the mud at the bottom of the ocean and ambushes passing prey.

myxostomata.name: Myxostomata
myxostomata.description: This exceptionally rare breed of fish is almost extinct, as its gilded Orokin flesh has a special savor for predators. It warily conceals itself in caves.
